description: This file implements the IDF (Inverse Document Frequency) feature transformer for Spark's MLlib, including classes for computing IDF from datasets and applying the transformation to vectors.

classes.name: IDF
classes.description: Class for computing IDF values from a dataset of vectors, supporting filtering by minimum document frequency.

classes.name: IDF.DocumentFrequencyAggregator
classes.description: Helper class for aggregating document frequency counts across a dataset.

classes.name: IDFModel
classes.description: Model class that applies the IDF transformation to vectors.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Computes IDF values from an RDD or JavaRDD of vectors.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms vectors from TF to TF-IDF using the stored IDF vector.
